    org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerChatEvent
    This event will fire from the main thread and allows the use of all of the Bukkit API, unlike the AsyncPlayerChatEvent.

    Listening to this event forces chat to wait for the main thread which causes delays for chat. AsyncPlayerChatEvent is the encouraged alternative for thread safe implementations. 此事件将在主线程上触发，与 AsyncPlayerChatEvent 不同，它允许使用全部 Bukkit API。监听此事件会迫使聊天等待主线程，从而导致聊天延迟。对于线程安全的实现，推荐使用 AsyncPlayerChatEvent 作为替代。

    org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerInventoryEvent
    Use InventoryClickEvent or InventoryOpenEvent instead, or one of the other inventory events in org.bukkit.event.inventory. 请改用 InventoryClickEvent 或 InventoryOpenEvent，或 org.bukkit.event.inventory 中的其他物品栏事件。
    org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerPreLoginEvent
    This event causes synchronization from the login thread; AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent is preferred to keep the secondary threads asynchronous. 此事件会导致登录线程的同步；为保持辅助线程异步，推荐使用 AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent。
